note: Databricks foundation models from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google support pay-per-token and provisioned throughput pricing.
Foundation Model APIs include Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, and Google Gemini with pay-per-token and provisioned throughput pricing.
Claude models range from Haiku to Opus including Sonnet and Fable.
OpenAI GPT models include current versions, legacy support, and open-source variants.
Google Gemini and Gemma models are available for language and embedding tasks.
Meta Llama models and community open-source models are available for deployment.
Regional providers including Qwen, GLM, and Kimi offer market-specific models.
Model versions provides availability, retirement, and lifecycle information for foundation models on Databricks.
The supported-models matrix lists real-time model availability by region.
Gemini 2.5 models retired October 2 and DeepSeek V4 Flash retires November 5.
Tracks major model updates like Claude 5.5 to 6 and GPT-5 to 6 transitions.
Databricks governs access to externally hosted models through Unity Catalog and the Gateway.
Routes requests to OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google hosted endpoints.
Fallback routing selects alternative external models when a provider is unavailable.
Cost attribution tracks external API spending per team with Gateway-enforced usage controls.
Model lifecycle churn tracks the October 2026 retirements and deprecations of foundation models.
Gemini 2.5 Pro and Flash retired October 2, 2026 with migration to Gemini 3.1 or 3.5 recommended.
GLM from Zhipu AI became legacy as of October 6, 2026.
DeepSeek V4 Flash retiring November 5, 2026 with V4.1 available as a replacement.
Databricks Data Foundation for AI builds on Delta Lake to provide governed, scalable data infrastructure.
Delta Lake provides open ACID transactions for both batch and streaming data workloads.
Schema enforcement validates incoming data against defined schemas to prevent quality drift.
Governed metadata layer tracks data lineage and versioning through Unity Catalog for consistent access control.
Multi-cloud support deploys Delta Lake across AWS, Azure, and GCP with unified governance.
Lakeflow provides data ingestion, orchestration, and transformation components for building data pipelines.
Lakeflow Connect automates data ingestion from diverse sources including databases and SaaS.
Lakeflow Designer provides a visual canvas with natural language interface for building data transformations.
Lakeflow Jobs orchestrates and monitors data, analytics, and AI workflows.
Genie Code integration enables natural language descriptions of transformations and AI function enrichment.
Lakebase provides serverless PostgreSQL storage for agent state and application data with Unity Catalog integration.
Unity Catalog synchronization enables bidirectional sync between Postgres tables and Delta Lake.
Lakebase Search combines vector and keyword search within PostgreSQL without requiring a separate vector database.
Hybrid search using Reciprocal Rank Fusion merges semantic and keyword results for comprehensive results.
Native Postgres integration co-locates search and application memory without requiring external vector stores.
Predictive Optimization automatically tunes Delta tables on Unity Catalog using ROI-based optimization.
Automatic VACUUM removes old table versions to optimize storage without manual intervention.
Audit trail stores optimization decisions in system.storage.predictive_optimization_operations_history.
